items.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
items.lead_paragraph: GPT-6 models design protein structures and sequences using reasoning and code. Lab tests found evidence of binding across five targets.

items.title: Searching for distant planets with Astra
items.lead_paragraph: See how two amateur astronomers used Codex and Astra to find potential exoplanets in public data from NASA’s Kepler and TESS space telescopes.

items.lead_paragraph: ChatGPT and Codex integrations help Clay’s users research deals and turn data into go-to-market plays, with GPT-6 models handling the reasoning.

items.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux. It helps teams protect running systems while they roll out patches.

items.title: Connected intelligence for in-house legal
items.lead_paragraph: Watch OpenAI’s Stacey Wang and Craig Bruney, Mary O’Carroll of LECG, and Cooley’s Richard Segal explore how AI can help in-house legal teams connect business context, build reusable workflows and get more from outside counsel.

items.title: Richpanel helps companies automate 50% of support in 30 days
items.lead_paragraph: Richpanel uses GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol to equip its AI support agents with tools and procedures, and GPT-6 Luna for their conversations.

items.title: Perplexity and Intelligence
items.lead_paragraph: How perplexity measures progress in AI models, and why it could help developers establish a shared approach to evaluating emerging capabilities.

items.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
items.lead_paragraph: OpenAI’s layered approach to adversarial distillation combines model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement to protect against capability extraction.

items.title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
items.lead_paragraph: Hebbia tested GPT-6 Astra for financial research. Its prerelease evaluations found gains in source coverage, citation relevance, and presentation quality.

items.title: Can AI help scientists identify promising drug candidates?
items.lead_paragraph: MedChemBench evaluates how well AI models interpret molecular structures, reason from experimental evidence, and select compounds in early drug discovery.

items.title: How OpenAI’s Performance Factory keeps ChatGPT fast
items.lead_paragraph: Learn how OpenAI built the Performance Factory, a system of Codex-powered workflows that finds and fixes performance issues to help keep ChatGPT fast.

items.title: See PR scans in action
items.lead_paragraph: Watch a walkthrough of PR scans and see how the presenter reviews scan results in a pull request workflow.

items.title: How Sumitomo Life’s leaders helped teams adopt ChatGPT Enterprise
items.lead_paragraph: Sumitomo Life uses ChatGPT Enterprise to research insurers, prepare proposals, and draft code for investment analysis. Early use by executives helped drive adoption.
